{{Quote|I'm going to need to see further identification.''"<br />"''It's all there, Sergeant. I'm a member in good standing of the Republic Senate.''"<br />"''So it says. But I'm still going to need to see further identification.|A clone shock trooper talking with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] at a checkpoint|<ref name="LabEvil">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>}}
'''Clone shock troopers''' were highly skilled [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that formed the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. They were trained as elite [[Shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]] specifically for deployment on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and to provide security aboard Republic [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. There, as well as on a few other select [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] shock troopers served primarily as [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security police]] for Republic government buildings such as the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] and as [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|prison]] guards. They also served as [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] for Republic [[Senator/Legends|officials]] and as urban [[Police officer/Legends|peacekeepers]] with [[Riot clone trooper/Legends|some troopers]] trained specifically for [[riot]] control. In addition to the civilian police on Republic worlds, as military police they could take over investigations as well and were treated as regular patrolling police when they were out and about.

==History==
{{Quote|We've secured the Hutt location, sir. Senator Amidala's unharmed and she's returning to the Senate with her protocol droid. We have Lord Ziro in custody. He's claiming he was forced into the kidnapping of Jabba's son by Count Dooku. Zero casualties&mdash;unless you count droids, of course.|[[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Fox/Legends|Fox]], reporting the successful hostage extraction|<ref name="TCW book">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref>}}
{{Main|Coruscant Guard/Legends}}
{{SeeAlso|Homeworld Security Command}}
With the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|eruption]] of [[Clone Wars/Legends|war]] between the Galactic Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the clone shock troopers [[Cloning/Legends|grown]] on the planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] were put into full operation in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. However, certain clones had been secretly transferred and grown in secret facilities on Coruscant.<ref name="GAR Guide">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref> The clone [[Shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]] were established as the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] shortly after the start of the war.<ref name="CSWEthire" /> Their primary purpose was to serve as a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security police]] for Republic government buildings,<ref name="LabEvil" /> Coruscant's [[Central power distribution grid/Legends|infrastructure]],<ref name="TCWheros">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref> banks, plazas, and landing platforms<ref name="LabEvil" /> as well as guards at the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]].<ref name="TCWdeception">{{TCW|Deception}}</ref>

[[File:Clone_Shock_Trooper_05.png|thumb|left|250px|Shock troopers escorting Darth Sidious on Mustafar]]
Though the Coruscant Guard was meant to only supplement the civilian [[Police officer/Legends|forces]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]], in charge of policing [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], and the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]], in charge of protecting [[Senator/Legends|senators]], dignitaries and the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]], the shock troopers soon found themselves conducting regular policing duties<ref name="SWCE">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> such as [[Raid on Ziro the Hutt's Coruscant club|raids]],<ref name="TCWfilm">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|hostage rescues]],<ref name="TCWhostage">{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}</ref> and [[Riot clone trooper/Legends|riot suppression]].<ref name="TCWdom">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref> The Coruscant Guard's [[Diplomatic Escort Group]] would be assigned to accompany diplomats and senators, such as Padmé Amidala, a role previously held solely by the Senate Guard.<ref name="TCWambush">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref>

As the war continued, the Coruscant Guard became the most visible element of the [[Homeworld Security Command]]. Shock troopers were called in more and more for police duties and had the authority to demand of anyone to reveal their identification on the spot and perform other random security checks. Rumors of searches of houses without just cause and brutal suppression of protesters in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|lower levels]] existed though were not confirmed by government authorities.<ref name="LabEvil" /> This reputation gained the clone shock troopers the nickname "[[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]," a term later applied to all clone troopers after the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="The Clone Wars Campaign Guide">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

After newly proclaimed [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] established the Empire,<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref> the Coruscant Guard became the primary force responsible for security on Coruscant.<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> The term "clone shock trooper" was discontinued and members of the Guard were instead referred to as either "Coruscant Guards" or "Elite Stormtroopers." The original clone shock troopers themselves were also phased out in favor of younger and Imperial indoctrinated stormtroopers.<ref name="501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>

==Equipment==
[[File:CoruscantGuard1-OutFoxed.png|thumb|200px|A shock trooper in Phase 1 clone trooper armor]]
{{Quote|Jek. Concerned about weapons you are. Weapons do not win battles. Your mind, powerful it is! Mmm? Out think the droids you can.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to shock trooper [[Jek/Legends|Jek]]|<ref name="TCWambush" />}}
Shock troopers were issued the [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] with their initial deployment to Coruscant. Unlike most other clones who were issued white with officers bearing color markings, the Coruscant Guard [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]] was issued in [[Color/Legends|red]].<ref name="TCWfilm" /> The color scheme made the shock troopers a very distinctive unit within the Grand Army. With the introduction of the [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]], the red color scheme continued and a majority of the armor was covered in red. The paint markings were unique designations for the planet of Coruscant, and would later become the de facto color for all things Senatorial and Coruscant executive, during the Clone Wars. Shock troopers wore specialized helmets, with upgraded breath filters and annunciators.<ref name="RotS VD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> It remained such a distinctive armor scheme that the Imperial era [[Coruscant Guard armor]] was covered completely in red.<ref name="501st" />

Shock troopers were armed with [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]], [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15Ss]], and [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]]. They were also seen armed with [[RPS-6 rocket launcher/Legends|RPS-6 rocket launchers]], and [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon/Legends|Z-6 rotary blaster cannons]] during battle. They also employed [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaffs]] for combat.<ref name="TCWambush" />

==Behind the scenes==
While all canonically-seen shock troopers had red armor highlights, a promotional card for Official Pix sent with the [[2006]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] Fan Club membership kit depicted a shock trooper with blue paint instead of red, but otherwise identical in appearance. The possible canonicity of this color scheme, and of whether those who wore it were indeed part of the shock trooper corps, remains ambiguous.
